what: Solid-filled text laid over large outline-only lines is painted from the left as you scroll. It runs from when the panel’s top edge reaches 65% of the screen until its bottom edge reaches 60%, with no curve, staggered .6 per line, clip-path inset(−.35em 100% −.45em 0) → inset(−.35em 0 −.45em 0). The dimension note beside it fades from progress .4 down to .15. Scrolling back empties it again.

options.dim: Opacity at which annotations fade, default .15
options.[data-fx-part=line]: One line (where outlined text and solid text overlap)
options.[data-fx-part=ghost]: Outline text (optional — the part css draws it with a 32% ink border)
options.[data-fx-part=solid]: Filled text (required) — overlaps the line as is
